High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready copy of the Players Committee virtual card [[Chief Bast (V)]] (Virtual Set 9, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Virtual Cards/Set 9/Dark/Chief Bast.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1n9KDd_6LUSPDKKC0XLJtyjbzvJSQG-jq/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Chief Bast.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,339,312 bytes, SHA-256 <code>bd71a4b6df496524ddef134594645e1a16128dd475e7cc7d88de2304333b1173</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 46.0, 47.5, 74.0, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:V9-D-chiefbast-2018-07-08.gif]].

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
